children.text: SAIS - Abu Dhabi opened its doors in 2019, launching a purposeful and transformative educational mission. From day one, the school has been deeply committed to fostering academic excellence, innovation, and global citizenship in every student.

Our journey is inspired by the visionary leadership of Her Excellency Dr. Aysha Al Sayyar and Dr. Nawaf Fawaz, who established the first SAIS campus in Sharjah in 1997, followed by campuses in Dubai (2005) and Umm Al Quwain (2012). Their forward-thinking mission was and remains clear: to nurture a generation that is academically strong, morally grounded, and future-ready.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi reception lobby

children.text: We have cultivated a culture of achievement. In just a few short years, we earned a “Very Good” rating from ADEK, with “Outstanding” recognition in key areas such as student responsibility and innovation skills. In 2024, we proudly received ADEK’s Outstanding MAP Progress Award, a testament to the dedication and excellence of our students, educators, and leadership team.

Our success is driven by a collaborative community, committed senior and middle leaders, passionate teachers, and actively engaged parents. Together, we work to fulfill our school’s mission to empower every student to reach their full potential.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi teacher guiding two students in class

children.text: Our staff communicate with stakeholders through various channels to ensure students’ wellbeing and academic success. Teachers create an inclusive environment by planning lessons that meet the needs of all learners, including students of determination and those who are gifted and talented. Student-led national and international events are regularly held at the school, helping students stay actively engaged with the wider community.

At SAIS - Abu Dhabi, we are committed to preparing our students to become lifelong learners who are curious, resilient, and driven to grow. We focus on developing strong character values such as integrity, respect, and responsibility. Through academic and personal development, we encourage our students to contribute positively to their community and make a meaningful difference in the world around them.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students

children.text: This journey is rooted in the visionary leadership of Her Excellency Dr. Aysha Al Sayyar and Dr. Nawaf Fawaz, who established the first SAIS campus in Sharjah in 1997, followed by the Dubai campus in 2005 and the Umm Al Quwain campus in 2012. Their forward-thinking vision was clear: to build a generation that is academically strong, morally grounded, and fully prepared for the future.

At SAIS - Abu Dhabi, we’ve cultivated a culture of achievement. In a short span of time, we have made remarkable progress, culminating in earning a “Very Good” rating from ADEK, with “Outstanding” recognition in key areas such as students’ responsibility and innovation skills. In 2024, we were honored to receive ADEK’s Outstanding MAP Progress Award, a reflection of the tireless efforts of our students, teachers, and leadership team.

heading.title: The journey of SAIS - Abu Dhabi began in 2019, marking the start of a purposeful and transformative educational mission. From its first day, the school has been deeply committed to fostering excellence, innovation, and a sense of global citizenship among its students.

children.text: Every step forward has been powered by our dedicated senior and middle leaders, our passionate teaching staff, and our engaged and supportive parent community. Together, we remain committed to realizing our school’s vision and mission, ensuring that every student is empowered to achieve their full potential.

From environmental sustainability projects to innovative STEM and Makerspace labs, from wellbeing programs to vibrant sports and extracurricular offerings, every element of our school is designed to nurture future-ready learners.
SAIS - Abu Dhabi is not just a school; it is a thriving learning community, a hub of innovation, and a place where success is not only achieved but sustained.

children.text: Dear valued students, dedicated staff, and supportive parents,

It is with great pride that I welcome you to SAIS - Abu Dhabi, a school where we nurture an enriching, inclusive environment, celebrating the uniqueness of every child and fostering a deep sense of belonging.
At SAIS, our philosophy goes beyond academics. We believe in building character and equipping students with practical life skills. Empowering future leaders who are ready to face challenges and excel in all areas of life is at the heart of our mission. This commitment to holistic development forms the foundation of our school’s vision.

We hold ourselves to the highest standards, expecting excellence from every member of our community. Guided by our mission and vision, we are committed to preparing students to become responsible, confident individuals. Throughout their educational journey, students are continuously encouraged to act as role models, demonstrating integrity, leadership, and respect in all aspects of school life.

Leadership grows through opportunity. We provide a safe, nurturing environment where students are taught to respect and value others and to engage as responsible citizens. We are proud to share that ADEK has rated us Outstanding in students’ social responsibility and innovation skills.

From Pre-KG to Grade 12, we offer a high-quality American curriculum enriched with innovation and real-world application. Our programs include STEM, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Project-Based Learning (PBL), and a strong high school program. Students benefit from a wide range of electives such as Human Anatomy, Organic Chemistry, Design & Technology, Business Studies, Programming, and AP College Board courses. As a certified SAT, AP, and IELTS center, we ensure that students are prepared for various university pathways: the General, General+, and Advanced tracks.

We also take great pride in preserving and promoting our heritage subjects, enabling students to develop a deep appreciation of local culture, Arabic language, and values.
Our dedicated teachers are committed to nurturing each student’s growth academically, socially, and emotionally. We strive not only to help students meet high standards but to exceed their own expectations. Parents are key partners in this journey, and we deeply value their involvement and voice through committees like the Parent Advisory Council and National Identity Committee.

Beyond the classroom, we offer a rich After-School Activities (ASA) program and a variety of extracurricular opportunities, including MUN (Model United Nations), public speaking, arts conferences, and more. Our students actively contribute to the Abu Dhabi community by completing internal and external volunteer service hours, strengthening their leadership skills and engagement.
We believe in education that makes a tangible, positive difference in the lives of our students and equips them with the skills they need for lifelong sustainable success.
It would be an honor to welcome you to our SAIS community. Together, let us continue building a future rooted in excellence, compassion, and ambition.

Sincerely,
Principal Ban Al Duri

children.text: The Abu Dhabi Department of Education and Knowledge (ADEK) is the regulatory authority responsible for overseeing and enhancing the quality of education across schools in Abu Dhabi. Through its comprehensive inspection framework, ADEK evaluates schools against key standards including student achievement, teaching and assessment, curriculum quality, student wellbeing, and leadership. We are proud to share that our school has been awarded a “Very Good” rating in the 2024–2025 ADEK Irtiqa’a inspection, reflecting our strong commitment to academic excellence, high-quality teaching and learning, student care, and continuous school improvement.

children.text: High School Pathways function like college majors, but begin during the high school experience. Every student can benefit from selecting and following a sequence of career-related classes aligned with their interests.
A Pathway:
Provides a sequence of courses within your area of interest
Connects your career interests from high school to college and/or career
Serves as an educational roadmap guiding you to relevant high school courses and post-secondary options
Helps you acquire knowledge and skills linked to specific post-secondary programs leading to certificates, degrees, and careers

cards.description:
Students in this pathway solve problems, develop new technologies, and drive innovation. This rigorous college preparatory curriculum focuses on advanced mathematics and science, preparing students for university-level work.

Participants apply essential math and science content in real-world contexts. Career possibilities range from science and math educators to laboratory technicians to NASA astronauts.

cards.title: Science and Engineering Pathway

cards.description:
Students gain hands-on foundational skills in their chosen mode of expression, including:

•	Studio art
•	Fashion design
•	Interior design
•	Acting
•	Theater production
•	Vocal and instrumental performance
•	Film and audio production

This pathway develops cultural awareness alongside communication, creative, and critical thinking skills necessary for success across various fields. Graduates may seek direct employment as artists, musicians, designers, actors, or audio producers, or pursue bachelor’s or graduate degrees for careers in teaching, art direction, theater production, fashion, interior design, media arts, and film.

cards.description:
This pathway provides students with opportunities to develop skills for customer-focused careers and gain experience in technology, communication, and management. Students explore business ownership fundamentals and practice developing business plans while learning to organize and direct business operations.

Students investigate financial management, including how industry standards, economic factors, technological advancements, international influences, social trends, legal requirements, and ethical considerations impact business decisions. They learn to formulate and interpret financial information for decision-making, compliance, and risk management.

Career opportunities include entrepreneurship, sales, marketing, economics, management, accounting, banking, securities and investments, and other financial specializations.

children.text: The application process begins with the parent/guardian completing the official application form and signing the Entry Requirements and Commitment documents.
Once submitted to the Registrar’s Office, our team will schedule a specific date for your child’s placement assessments and interview.

Potential students seeking school admission will take placement tests in English and Mathematics as the first step in the admissions process. Test results will be reviewed by the relevant Head of School, Student Support Department, Deputy Principal, or the school Principal.
Parents or guardians will be contacted to arrange an interview for you and your child/children.
Following successful completion of all placement requirements, the registration process commences. During this stage, parents/guardians must submit all required documentation to finalize enrollment.
For comprehensive information regarding registration procedures, fee structure, curriculum details, and additional school information, please consult the 2025 School Guide.
When applying, please provide the following documents:
Original Emirates ID cards (parents and child)
Previous school academic records
Parents’ passport copies with visa pages
Child’s vaccination records
Child’s birth certificate
Eight passport-sized photographs
Child’s passport with visa page

children.text: At SAIS - Abu Dhabi, our admissions process is designed to be welcoming, transparent, and student-centered.
We are committed to enrolling students who demonstrate a readiness to thrive in our academically rigorous and values-driven learning environment.

Our admissions team provides personalized support to families throughout the application process, ensuring a smooth transition into the SAIS community. We invite prospective parents and students to visit our campus, meet our faculty, and discover how SAIS fosters academic excellence, character development, and global citizenship from KG to Grade 12.

heading.title: Begin Your Child’s Journey With Us

children.text: Our admissions team is here to guide you through each step of the application process and answer any questions you may have. We welcome families who are looking for a school that combines academic excellence, strong values, and meaningful opportunities for personal growth.

Please note that school fees for the upcoming academic year are subject to change in accordance with Article 51 of the Bylaw of Federal Law No. (28) of 1999 Concerning Private Education and applicable regulations.
All tuition fees must be settled on or before the specified due dates as defined in the payment plan.
The registration fee is deducted from tuition fees upon enrollment.
An early payment discount is available for full payment made before the commencement of Term One.
For post-dated checks (PDCs), amounts will be considered paid only after successful clearance and credit to the school’s bank account.
A service charge of AED 500 will be applied for any checks returned by the bank.
Parents/guardians will be billed for any damage to school property caused by their child.
The registration fee is non-refundable and non-transferable under all circumstances.
School books and uniforms are non-refundable items.
Cash
Current-dated check
Post-dated checks
Credit card (Visa or Mastercard)
Wire transfer
Please note:
Current-dated or post-dated checks will not be accepted for initial academic year payments unless submitted at least one month before the academic year commences.
Fees are considered paid only when credited to the school’s bank account.
A student’s registration is considered complete only after the first payment has been cleared, whether made in cash, by credit card, or by wire transfer.
For wire transfers, all associated bank charges must be covered by the parent/guardian. Only the net amount received in the school’s account will be credited against outstanding fees.
The school reserves the following rights regarding non-payment of fees:
To send payment reminders via email, written notices, phone calls, SMS, and parent portal notifications to parents/guardians with outstanding payments.
To temporarily suspend students for up to three school days per term (consecutively or intermittently) after issuing three payment default notices.
To withhold the provision of learning resources, participation in extracurricular activities and field trips, and access to school ICT networks, library, laboratories, and other facilities.
To withhold transfer certificates, grade reports, mark sheets, transcripts, and recommendation letters for any student with outstanding fees.
To pursue appropriate legal action and/or inform relevant authorities to recover outstanding fees.
To claim legal fees and associated costs incurred in the recovery of outstanding fees.
In accordance with the Ministry of Education decree:
1. Parents/guardians must provide 30 days’ advance notice of student withdrawal and submit a formal refund request.
2. Withdrawal prior to the commencement of the academic year:
If initiated by the parent/guardian: The balance of the first term fee paid will be refunded; registration and admission fees remain non-refundable.
If initiated by the school: The amount corresponding to the first term fee paid is refunded, excluding the registration fee.
3. Withdrawal during the school term:
If a student attends any part of the first week or fails to attend without written notification one week before term commencement: The school retains the full registration or re-registration fee.
If a student attends two weeks or less in a term: The school will charge the equivalent of one full month of tuition fees.
If a student attends more than two weeks but less than one month: The school will charge the equivalent of two full months of tuition fees.
If a student attends more than one month in a term: The school will charge the full-term fee.
One month’s fee is calculated as one-tenth of the total annual school fees.

children.text: Our state-of-the-art facilities were created with our students’ best interests in mind; we took into account students’ academic and extracurricular needs and created a safe and welcoming learning environment for all students.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students in the library

children.text:
Our school is divided into separate sections for our KG department, elementary department, Middle and High School Boys Section, and Middle and High School Girls Section.

To meet our students’ academic needs in our KG Department, they have homeroom classes and benefit in their section from their own Music room, Literacy room, and STEAM room, which classes use on a daily rotational basis. To meet our students’ academic needs in our Elementary Department, they have homeroom classes and also have a Literacy Room dedicated to their own use, a STEAM room, and an Art room.

image.alt: SAIS students and staff meeting in a modern campus learning space

children.text: In our Middle and High School Boys and Girls Sections, students have subject and homeroom classrooms. We also have a large secondary library where students are able to go to conduct research, check out reading material, etc. Students also benefit from having an Islamic room, French room, Art room, Music room, and Arabic language rooms.

Taking into account the extended extracurricular activities that we offer our students here at SAIS - Abu Dhabi, our facilities are a highlight for many of our students. We have both a girls’ and a boys’ indoor gym for physical education classes.
Our campus also offers volleyball courts, basketball courts, soccer fields, and two swimming pools.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi girls playing basketball on the school court

children.text: Our classrooms are purposefully designed to provide a structured, inclusive, and stimulating learning environment that supports both academic achievement and student wellbeing. Each student is provided with an individual desk, and seating arrangements are carefully organized to promote attentiveness, comfort, and positive engagement in learning.

Classrooms are fully equipped with the resources and technology necessary to support diverse learning needs and ensure that students can access information through a range of approaches, including verbal instruction, written materials, listening activities, and interactive experiences. Facilities include interactive screens, whiteboards, student lockers, and well-organized learning spaces. In addition, desks are arranged to facilitate collaborative group work, fostering teamwork, communication, and active participation as essential components of the learning process.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi teacher guiding students at their desks

children.text: Our school library is a vibrant, multi-purpose space at the heart of student learning and creativity. It features a carefully curated collection of diverse books, selected to inspire a love of reading across all age groups and support academic growth in every subject area.

Equipped with a dedicated research computer center, the library also serves as a hub for inquiry-based learning and digital exploration. Beyond books and research, the space hosts a variety of engaging activities from reading events and storytelling sessions to workshops, meetings, and school assemblies.

Adding to its dynamic role, the library also houses the school’s radio station corner, where students develop their communication skills and broadcast school news and announcements. Whether for quiet study, collaborative projects, or creative events, our library is a welcoming and essential part of the school community.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students reading together in the library

children.text: Our Makerspace is a dynamic innovation hub where students develop creativity, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills through hands-on, project-based learning (PBL). It provides an inspiring environment in which students can plan, sketch, prototype, program, and create while transforming their ideas into practical solutions.

Equipped with a wide range of advanced tools and technologies, including laser cutters, wood-cutting machines, 3D printers, LEGO® Education SPIKE™ Prime kits, WhaleBot robotics tools, and other STEAM resources, the Makerspace enables students to actively engage in Design and Technology, STEAM, robotics, engineering, programming, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) through meaningful and innovative learning experiences.

Through experimentation, design challenges, coding activities, and collaborative projects, students strengthen their creativity, technical knowledge, and innovation skills while preparing for the opportunities and challenges of a rapidly evolving world.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students working in the Makerspace

children.text: Our school’s gym facilities provide students with a safe, well-equipped, and inclusive environment that promotes physical fitness, teamwork, and overall wellbeing. The school has two dedicated gym areas, one for boys and one for girls, ensuring that all students can participate in physical education and sports activities comfortably and confidently. Both gyms are equipped to support a range of activities, including football, volleyball, basketball, and padel, offering students opportunities to develop their physical skills, coordination, teamwork, and sportsmanship. These spaces are designed to encourage active lifestyles while ensuring that students learn, train, and play in a secure and well-supervised setting.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students training on the football pitch

children.text: Our swimming pool offers a safe and well-maintained environment where students develop essential swimming skills, water safety awareness, and overall fitness. Lessons are delivered by qualified and trained swimming instructors, ensuring high-quality coaching and close supervision at all times. Through structured activities, students build confidence in the water while improving technique, coordination, and overall wellbeing. The pool supports an active and healthy lifestyle within a secure and carefully monitored setting.

children.text: We believe that a thriving school community is built on the principles of care, collaboration, and mutual respect. Our diverse network of students, families, and staff forms a cohesive environment where everyone is valued and supported.

Through consistent communication, inclusive practices, and shared goals, we foster a culture that promotes academic excellence, social responsibility, and personal development. From parent partnerships to student-led initiatives, the Student Government Association, and schoolwide events, our collaborative spirit ensures that every member of the SAIS community plays an important role in shaping a positive and enriching school experience. We foster meaningful relationships that empower our learners and strengthen our school spirit.

children.text: At SAIS - Abu Dhabi, ensuring the wellbeing of our entire community remains a cornerstone of our educational philosophy. This commitment has taken on even greater significance in challenging times. We are dedicated to supporting the academic, mental, social, emotional, and physical wellbeing of all students and staff members.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students smiling in class

cards.description: Schoolwide events and targeted awareness campaigns.
Wellbeing-oriented sessions for staff.
Diverse communication channels for wellbeing-focused education for students, staff, and parents.

icon.alt: People connected around a chat bubble

cards.description: Open door policy for wellbeing-related concerns for all stakeholders.

children.text: At SAIS - Abu Dhabi, we adopt a proactive and preventative approach to student and staff wellbeing, in alignment with ADEK standards. Our approach includes:
We provide comprehensive support for students and staff who have experienced difficulties:
Professional counseling sessions and emotional support from qualified social-emotional counselors, wellbeing leads, and guidance counselors.
Group sessions and workshops for students and staff focused on a range of wellbeing themes.
Personalized recovery pathways to restore wellbeing.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi counselor working with students

children.text: The Social and Emotional Learning (SEL) program supports students in developing essential life skills that promote wellbeing, resilience, and positive relationships. Through structured activities and guided experiences, students build self-awareness, emotional regulation, responsible decision-making, and social skills, enabling them to thrive both academically and personally.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students sharing lunch together

children.text: At our school, wellbeing is promoted through daily practices and structured programs, including Social and Emotional Learning (SEL) sessions, counseling support, and wellbeing initiatives. Teachers integrate regular check-ins, positive reinforcement, and inclusive strategies within their classrooms, while the school engages parents and provides early intervention when needed to ensure every student feels supported, safe, and ready to succeed.
